summary: Frontend-only testing of Phase 1 SEO expansion: 5 new service pages, /human-risk-simulation, /client-success, homepage cross-links (CoreServices cards, CyberGame learn-more, CaseStudy view-all), Footer Services column, Navigation Human Risk link, and sitemap.xml. All new features verified working with zero bugs found. Regression spot-check of pre-existing routes (AI cluster page, industry page, BTA, service area page) all pass unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean and well-organized: ServicePage, HumanRiskSimulation, ClientSuccess each split into small focused subcomponents (Hero, AnswerBox, FAQ, CTA, Footer, Nav, schemas file) - good separation of concerns.
HRSSimulationEmbed correctly reuses the exact same <CyberGame/> component (DRY, no duplicated game logic) - verified functionally identical to homepage version.

ClientSuccess dedup logic (usedIndices Set from only the 3 featured industries' testimonialIndices) correctly produces no duplicate testimonials between industry sections and General section - verified via data trace (18 total testimonials, 9 used by featured industries, 9 in General, zero overlap).
All new JSON-LD schema blocks parse without errors on all 7 new pages (13 script tags on service/HRS pages, 12 on client-success).
Sitemap.xml is valid XML, all 8 new URLs present, all pre-existing entries intact.
test_credentials: None required - public marketing site, no auth tested
seed_data_creation: None - no backend/data mutations needed for this frontend batch
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified in this pass: (1) Homepage regression - all sections intact incl. cyber-game-section, case-study-section, core-services-section, footer. (2) CoreServices cards 0-4 are now <a> tags with correct hrefs to /services/:slug. (3) All 5 /services/:slug pages load with unique titles/meta/content, all required data-testids (hero, answer-box, benefits 0-4, detail-0, industry-examples 0-3 which correctly navigate to /industries/:slug, faq-0, hero-cta, bottom CTA to BTA), valid JSON-LD. (4) /human-risk-simulation has all required data-testids, and the embedded CyberGame was actually played through a full Awareness round (5 scenarios) to the results screen showing Human Risk Score 40/100, badges earned, and lead capture form fields (name/email/company) - fully functional, not just visually present. (5) /client-success shows hero+4 metrics, 3 industry sections (financial/manufacturing/construction) each linking correctly to /industries/:slug, General MSP section with non-duplicated testimonials, bottom CTA to BTA. (6) Footer Services column has all 7 new links (5 services + HRS + client-success) all present and correctly pointing to right routes; existing Navigate/Contact/Credentials columns untouched. (7) Nav has nav-human-risk-simulation between Risk Score and ROI Calculator (desktop); mobile-nav-human-risk-simulation confirmed in code. (8) cyber-game-learn-more and case-study-view-all-link both present and functional, without disrupting existing game/carousel. (9) sitemap.xml valid, all 8 new URLs present, old entries unchanged. (10) EbookPopup confirmed absent on both new dedicated pages (HRS and client-success) via DOM query. (11) Spot-checked 4 pre-existing routes (AI cluster page, industry page, BTA, service area page) - all load fine with correct titles, no regressions. No bugs found in this session - clean pass.
